text:
Maya: Quick heads-up20	3pawn partner EdgeWorks wants to replay device hourly batches up to 6 days and expects automatic credits. need policy + eng constraints.

Luis: 6 days is too long for auto-credit. we need idempotency keys. can they provide a monotonic batch_id + per-device seq?

EdgeOps Bot: schema uploaded: /schemas/edgeworks/usage_v1.json; sample attached.

Rachel: finance preference = 24h auto-credit, ingest up to 7d flagged for review. any auto-credit beyond 24h needs partner SLA and capped monthly liability.

Tom: support impact: Console should show original signed_ts and mark records as "replayed" so CS can explain credits. also canned replies for customers.

Maya: partner claims many devices in rural regions buffer 4-5 days. they want us to accept 6d auto-credit. can we offer a tiered contract?

Luis: engineering proposal: require JWT signature + unique constraint on (partner_id, batch_id). ingestion rules: if signed_at >= now-24h -> auto-credit; if now-6d <= signed_at < now-24h -> ingest but ledger_state=review_required; signed_at < now-6d -> reject. allow exceptions for "pilot" partners who implement monotonic seq + replay_rate SLA to get 72h auto-credit for 30d pilot.

Rachel: finance OK to pilot 72h auto-credit with strict caps and telemetry. need rollback trigger (e.g., replay credits >0.2% of daily revenue).

Tom: I'll prototype Console columns: partner_batch, replay_id, signed_at, ledger_state, auto_credit_applied. also KB draft: "How backdated device usage is handled".

Maya: owners: Luis (eng) build idempotency & JWT check, Rachel (finance) set pilot caps & rollback, Tom (support) KB & Console, Maya (partnerships) to negotiate pilot. I'll tell EdgeWorks we can do default 24h auto-credit with pilot path.

EdgeOps Bot: partner acknowledged and uploaded test bundle: s3://edgeworks-tests/replay-sample-20260321.tar.gz

Luis: I'll run a smoke dedupe test against sample and post results. command: ./tools/replay-check --input s3://edgeworks-tests/replay-sample-20260321.tar.gz --keys partner_id,batch_id --window 6d --autocredit 24h

Maya: thanks. decision communicated to partner: default policy with pilot option. closing unless blockers.
